name: Geotrixe Content Protector & Image Watermarker
author: geotrixe

sections.description:
Geotrixe Content Protector & Image Watermarker is a comprehensive WordPress plugin designed to help protect your website content from unauthorized copying and theft. The plugin provides multiple layers of protection to safeguard your text and images.

Key Features

  • Disable Right-Click: Prevents users from accessing the context menu on your website
  • Disable Text Selection: Makes it difficult for users to select and copy text content
  • Disable Copy/Paste Shortcuts: Blocks common keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, etc.)
  • Customizable Popup Messages: Display custom warning messages when users attempt to copy content
  • Per-Post/Page Exclusions: Exclude specific posts or pages from protection if needed
  • Image Watermarking: Automatically add watermarks to uploaded images to protect your visual content
  • Watermark Customization: Choose watermark position (top-left, center, bottom-right) and use custom watermark images or text
  • User-Friendly Settings: Easy-to-use admin interface with tabbed settings pages

How It Works

The plugin uses JavaScript to disable common content copying methods on the frontend of your website. For images, it automatically applies watermarks when images are uploaded to your Media Library using either Imagick (preferred) or GD library. You can customize all protection settings from the WordPress admin panel.

Use Cases

  • Bloggers and content creators who want to protect their original content
  • Photographers and artists who need to watermark their images
  • Business websites with proprietary information
  • Educational sites that want to prevent easy copying of course materials
  • Any website owner concerned about content theft

Important Notes

  • This plugin provides basic protection against casual copying but cannot prevent determined users from accessing your content
  • Some protection features may affect user experience – use the per-post exclusion feature for pages where users need to copy content
  • Image watermarks are applied during upload and cannot be removed without re-uploading the image
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Geotrixe Content Protector & Image Watermarker”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click “Upload Plugin”
  5. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  6. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Go to Content Protection in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Configure your protection settings in the “General Protection” tab
  3. Set up image watermarking in the “Image Protection” tab (optional)
  4. Use the meta box on individual posts/pages to exclude them from protection if needed
sections.faq:
Does this plugin completely prevent content theft?

No. This plugin provides basic protection against casual copying but cannot prevent determined users from accessing your content. It’s designed to deter casual copying and make it more difficult to steal content.

Will this affect my website’s SEO?

No. The plugin only affects the frontend user experience and does not interfere with search engine crawling or indexing.

Can I exclude certain pages from protection?

Yes! Each post and page has a meta box that allows you to exclude it from protection. This is useful for pages where users need to copy content (like terms of service, code snippets, etc.).

How do I remove watermarks from images?

Watermarks are applied during upload. To remove a watermark, you’ll need to delete the image and upload it again without watermarking enabled, or edit the image file directly.

Does the plugin work with all themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with all WordPress themes. However, some themes with custom JavaScript may require minor adjustments.

Can I customize the watermark?

Yes! You can use a custom watermark image or text, and choose from three positions: top-left, center, or bottom-right.
